verdict.rationale: A data-use and training opt-out posture is a fair question for an AI inference product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no statement, policy, or control about whether user data is used to train models. Self-hosting and the air-gapped offline-docs flag are deployment conveniences, not a documented no-training guarantee, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
